description: Read-only stock carrier configuration, registration and optional IMS interface capture for the explicitly mapped FP6. Passing this suite proves readable evidence, not voice, SMS, data, VoLTE, VoWiFi or 5G behavior.

preconditions: The selected FP6 is authorized over the approved USB path.
The operator has confirmed the intended carrier and SIM arrangement without disclosing subscriber identifiers.

expected.description: Android returns a non-empty carrier configuration snapshot for private analysis.

preconditions: The intended SIM profile is active and has been allowed to register normally.
Airplane mode is off; no call, message or subscription change is performed by this case.

expected.description: Android returns a non-empty telephony registration snapshot for private analysis.

preconditions: IMS applicability is attributed to the installed build, plan provisioning and currently exposed Android service interface.

expected.description: The build exposes a non-empty IMS observation when this dumpsys interface is available.

applicability.skip_reason: The installed build does not expose the optional imsservice dumpsys interface; the limitation must remain explicit and IMS behavior still needs manual evidence.
